newsitem.title: USA: SCAC says Mideast talks satisfactory.
newsitem.headline: SCAC says Mideast talks satisfactory.

text.p: SCAC Holdings Corp, which recently acquired worldwide rights from Solplax Ltd for its Solplax PVA (plastic) technology, said contract negotiations on the product are moving satisfactorily in the Middle East.

Chairman Michael Cunningham described the contract negotiations with Middle Eastern countries as proceeding "very satisfactorily" and he expects to make a further announcement during the International Defense Exhibition, which is taking place in Dubai between March 16-21.
Solplax is a biodegradable replacement for a wide variety of plastics and plastic-related products.
